name: Taking Care Of Gods Temple
overview: Scripture reveals that God desires to dwell among His people, calling them to build a sanctuary as His holy temple (Exodus 25:8). Believers are urged to examine their lives and present their bodies as living sacrifices, holy and acceptable to God, reflecting the spiritual temple they embody (Romans 12:1; Haggai 1:7). Christ Himself identifies His body as the temple, promising resurrection and renewal beyond physical structures (John 2:19). Furthermore, the church is described as a unified, growing temple, built together in holiness through the Lord (Ephesians 2:21). Together, these verses emphasize the sacred responsibility of caring for God's temple both individually and corporately.
